messages:
sam: Heads-up — we have a planned change window Tue 2026-06-01 00:00-03:00 UTC. Goal: kernel patches + minor runtime pinning. Need a customer bulletin + status page snippet. Running a localized comms drill for EU/APAC, want sign-off today.

maria: SG. Drafted a short status snippet and a longer email body. Pasting both below for quick review.

maria: ```
Status page snippet (short):
We will perform a planned maintenance on Tue 2026-06-01 00:00–03:00 UTC to apply runtime patches and version pin updates. Some requests may see brief latency increases; no expected downtime. Updates will be posted here.
```

maria: ```
Email body (long):
Hi —
We will be performing a planned maintenance window on Tue 2026-06-01 between 00:00–03:00 UTC. This work updates kernel and runtime pinning to improve stability and prepare for upcoming model rollout features. During the window you may observe short-lived latency increases (seconds) for in-flight requests; persistent errors are not expected. If anything changes we will post updates on the status page and via SMS for subscribed accounts.

What we’re doing:
- Kernel maintenance on Dedicated hosts
- Runtime version pin and config refresh
- Non-disruptive KV cache priming

If you rely on strict tail-latency SLOs and need us to pin a specific model variant, reply to this message and we'll coordinate a temporary hold.

Thanks,
Redwood Platform Team
```

support-jordan: Couple of practical notes:
- Add an SMS fallback blurb for accounts opted into SMS (we should send local times for recipients)
- Include a very short 'what to expect' bullet for embeddings customers (token billing unaffected)

support-jordan: Also recommend adding a short post-maintenance validation line: "We will run a smoke-check across EU regions and post success marker." That helps CS triage.

deploy-bot: Deploybot: scheduled maintenance INC-4321 will be opened at 2026-06-01T00:00Z. Automated updates every 15m during the window. Will auto-close if no errors after 30m post-maint.

ops-maya: +1 to smoke-check. Also suggest we explicitly call out no change to data residency or exports, so customers in regulated verticals don't get alarmed.

legal-ella: Quick compliance note — please avoid wording like "no downtime guaranteed". Replace with "no expected downtime" and keep the rollback plan summary high-level.

sam: Good catches. I'll tweak wording: add SMS blurb, embeddings note, explicit data residency line, and change "guaranteed" -> "not expected". Will also append a short SLA/rollback note per legal.

maria: Also translating note — can we get FR/DE/ES and JP/KR localized snippets? I can handle FR/DE/ES. Need a volunteer for JP/KR or we can punt to translation vendor (longer lead). For the drill, we can publish English + FR/DE and mark JP/KR as pending.

sam: Ok — publish English + FR/DE as part of the drill. Support to queue SMS for EU recipients at 01:00 UTC. @support-jordan can you confirm SMS send list and timezones? We'll include localized time ranges in the SMS.

support-jordan: Confirmed — SMS queued for 01:00 UTC to EU opt-ins. Will send local time string for recipients. I’ll upload the final CSV and ping ops channel once ready.

maria: Updated the draft and pushed to /docs/maintenance/3421007890-bulletin-draft.md (internal). Link: https://redwood.internal/docs/maintenance/3421007890-bulletin-draft

sam: Thanks — final checklist before publish:
- [ ] Legal wording approved (legal-ella)
- [ ] SMS list + schedule (support-jordan)
- [ ] FR/DE translations (maria)
- [ ] Status page snippet ready (sam)
- [ ] Deploybot scheduled (deploy-bot)

legal-ella: Approved phrasing with edits. No further redlines.

sam: OK — publishing English + FR/DE to status page now as a drill. I’ll post live link and update this thread when status page is live.

statusbot: Status page updated: https://status.redwood.ai/incident/INC-4321 (DRILL) — initial message posted.

sam: Published. Link above. Treat this as a drill for EU/APAC localized comms. If no objections I'll proceed to trigger SMS at 01:00 UTC and mark JP/KR as pending translations.

ops-maya: 👍 all clear from ops side. Will run the preflight smoke checks 30m before window.

support-jordan: SMS queued and validated. I'll post a confirmation after the 01:00 send.

sam: Great — thanks everyone. Closing the thread; will reopen if translations or SLA flags come up.
